text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the third race of the
Classics and the
decider of whether Teio
can become a Triple
Crown
champion—the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All my fans are watching me. They're all
waiting to
see if I can nab the Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew... I wonder if this is how Prez felt.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What?! Prez is never scared and she
never ever
cries!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm sure it was a breeze for her! Like, whoosh and it was over!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Right. I gotta pull myself together too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be the Monarch who surpasses
even the
Emperor, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Here I go! The star of this race is
none
other than me, the great and
mighty Teio!
